content.text: Your diagnosis is wrong. The failed log shows `domain not allowed: api.deps.dev.` — egress-policy: block is rejecting a lookup the action makes to deps.dev, which it only calls when the PR touches a manifest (this PR changes requirements.txt; the last passing PR didn't touch any manifest, so it never needed that endpoint). Nothing about the harden-runner version differs in the runner's behavior here — the allow-list, not the pin, is the cause.

content.text:
Confirmed: `allowed-endpoints` never included `api.deps.dev`, in either version's config. Rolling back the pin to v2.20.0 would leave the exact same allow-list and fail identically the next time a PR touches a manifest — it wouldn't fix anything, and per this repo's own security posture, an unjustified pin downgrade weakens nothing here but is still the wrong fix for the actual bug.

The correct fix is adding `api.deps.dev:443` to `allowed-endpoints`. I'll make that change instead of touching the pin — say if you want the pin reverted anyway for unrelated reasons.
